css: @page{size:80mm auto;margin:0}body{background:#fff;color:#111;margin:0;font-family:Arial,'Noto Naskh Arabic',Tahoma,sans-serif}.pos-receipt{width:80mm;box-sizing:border-box;margin:0 auto;padding:4mm;direction:rtl;font-size:11px;line-height:1.42}.pos-title{text-align:center;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;margin:2px 0 0}.pos-number{text-align:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;margin:0 0 8px}.pos-center{text-align:center}.store-name{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;margin:5px 0 2px}.store-sub{font-size:10px;margin:1px 0}.meta{margin-top:8px}.meta-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin:3px 0}.meta-row .label{font-weight:900}.meta-row .value{direction:ltr;text-align:left;font-weight:800}.route{font-size:10px;text-align:center;margin:6px 0 2px}.dash{border-top:1px dashed #999;margin:8px 0}.items{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;direction:rtl}.items th{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;border-bottom:1px dashed #999;padding:4px 2px;text-align:right}.items td{font-size:11px;border-bottom:1px dashed #ddd;padding:5px 2px;vertical-align:top}.items .num{text-align:left;direction:ltr;font-weight:800}.items .desc{text-align:right;direction:rtl;unicode-bidi:plaintext;font-weight:800}.totals{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin-top:5px}.totals td{padding:3px 0;font-size:12px}.totals .amount{text-align:left;direction:ltr;font-weight:900}.grand td{font-size:18px;font-weight:900;border-top:1px solid #111;padding-top:6px}.vat-note{text-align:center;font-weight:900;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px}.footer{text-align:center;font-size:10px;margin-top:10px}.ltr{direction:ltr;unicode-bidi:embed}
name: Trip Invoice POS
